items.source: A note about modules: Spring Framework’s jars allow for deployment to the module path (Java Module System). For use in module-enabled applications, the Spring Framework jars come with Automatic-Module-Name manifest entries which define stable language-level module names (spring.core, spring.context, etc.) independent from jar artifact names. The jars follow the same naming pattern with - instead of . – for example, spring-core and spring-context. Of course, Spring Framework’s jars also work fine on the classpath.
items.translation: 关于模块的说明：Spring Framework 的 jar 包支持部署到模块路径（Java Module System）。在用于启用模块的应用程序中，Spring Framework 的 jar 包包含Automatic-Module-Name清单条目，这些条目定义了稳定的语言级模块名称（例如spring.core、spring.context等），且独立于 jar 包构件名称。jar 包的命名遵循相同的模式，仅将.替换为-——例如spring-core和spring-context。当然，Spring Framework 的 jar 包在类路径上也能正常工作。

items.source: The Spring Framework also supports the Dependency Injection (JSR 330) and Common Annotations (JSR 250) specifications, which application developers may choose to use instead of the Spring-specific mechanisms provided by the Spring Framework. Originally, those were based on common javax packages.
items.translation: Spring 框架还支持依赖注入（JSR 330）和通用注解（JSR 250）规范，应用程序开发人员可以选择使用这些规范，而不是 Spring 框架提供的特定于 Spring 的机制。最初，这些规范基于通用的 javax 包。

items.source: You can use start.spring.io to generate a basic project or follow one of the "Getting Started" guides, such as Getting Started Building a RESTful Web Service. As well as being easier to digest, these guides are very task focused, and most of them are based on Spring Boot. They also cover other projects from the Spring portfolio that you might want to consider when solving a particular problem.
items.translation: 您可以使用 start.spring.io 生成基本项目，或遵循以下任一“入门”指南，例如构建 RESTful Web 服务入门。这些指南不仅更易于消化，而且非常注重任务导向，其中大多数基于 Spring Boot。此外，它们还涵盖了您解决特定问题时可能需要考虑的其他 Spring 项目组合中的内容。

items.source: As of Spring Framework 6.0, Spring has been upgraded to the Jakarta EE 9 level (for example, Servlet 5.0+, JPA 3.0+), based on the jakarta namespace instead of the traditional javax packages. With EE 9 as the minimum and EE 10 supported already, Spring is prepared to provide out-of-the-box support for the further evolution of the Jakarta EE APIs. Spring Framework 6.0 is fully compatible with Tomcat 10.1, Jetty 11 as web servers, and also with Hibernate ORM 6.1.
items.translation: 自 Spring Framework 6.0 起，Spring 已升级至 Jakarta EE 9 级别（例如 Servlet 5.0+、JPA 3.0+），基于 jakarta 命名空间而非传统的 javax 包。随着 EE 9 成为最低要求且已支持 EE 10，Spring 已准备好为 Jakarta EE API 的进一步演进提供开箱即用的支持。Spring Framework 6.0 完全兼容 Tomcat 10.1、Jetty 11 作为 Web 服务器，同时也兼容 Hibernate ORM 6.1。

items.source: For how-to questions or diagnosing or debugging issues, we suggest using Stack Overflow. Click here for a list of the suggested tags to use on Stack Overflow. If you’re fairly certain that there is a problem in the Spring Framework or would like to suggest a feature, please use the GitHub Issues.
items.translation: 对于“如何操作”类问题或诊断、调试问题，我们建议使用 Stack Overflow。点击此处查看 Stack Overflow 上建议使用的标签列表。如果您相当确定 Spring Framework 中存在问题，或希望提出功能建议，请使用GitHub Issues。

items.source: Spring came into being in 2003 as a response to the complexity of the early J2EE specifications. While some consider Java EE and its modern-day successor Jakarta EE to be in competition with Spring, they are in fact complementary. The Spring programming model does not embrace the Jakarta EE platform specification; rather, it integrates with carefully selected individual specifications from the traditional EE umbrella:
items.translation: Spring 于 2003 年诞生，旨在应对早期 J2EE 规范的复杂性。虽然有人认为 Java EE 及其现代继任者 Jakarta EE 与 Spring 存在竞争关系，但实际上它们是互补的。Spring 编程模型并不采用 Jakarta EE 平台规范；相反，它集成了传统 EE 伞状结构下精心挑选的各个独立规范：

items.source: Spring continues to innovate and to evolve. Beyond the Spring Framework, there are other projects, such as Spring Boot, Spring Security, Spring Data, Spring Cloud, Spring Batch, among others. It’s important to remember that each project has its own source code repository, issue tracker, and release cadence. See spring.io/projects for the complete list of Spring projects.
items.translation: Spring 持续创新并不断演进。除了 Spring Framework，还有其他项目，例如 Spring Boot、Spring Security、Spring Data、Spring Cloud、Spring Batch 等。请记住，每个项目都有自己的源代码仓库、问题跟踪器和发布周期。有关 Spring 项目的完整列表，请参阅 spring.io/projects。

items.source: If you have a solution in mind or a suggested fix, you can submit a pull request on Github. However, please keep in mind that, for all but the most trivial issues, we expect a ticket to be filed in the issue tracker, where discussions take place and leave a record for future reference.
items.translation: 如果您有解决方案或建议的修复方法，可以在 Github 上提交拉取请求。但是，请注意，除了最琐碎的问题外，我们期望在问题跟踪器中提交工单，以便进行讨论并留下供将来参考的记录。

items.source: For more details see the guidelines at the CONTRIBUTING, top-level project page.
items.translation: 有关详细信息，请参阅顶级项目页面上的CONTRIBUTING指南。

items.source: If you are just getting started with Spring, you may want to begin using the Spring Framework by creating a Spring Boot-based application. Spring Boot provides a quick (and opinionated) way to create a production-ready Spring-based application. It is based on the Spring Framework, favors convention over configuration, and is designed to get you up and running as quickly as possible.
items.translation: 如果您刚开始使用 Spring，您可能希望通过创建一个基于 Spring Boot 的应用程序来开始使用 Spring Framework。Spring Boot 提供了一种快速（且带有特定观点）的方式来创建生产就绪的基于 Spring 的应用程序。它基于 Spring Framework，遵循约定优于配置的原则，并旨在让您尽可能快地启动和运行。

items.source:
Spring makes it easy to create Java enterprise applications. It provides everything you
need to embrace the Java language in an enterprise environment, with support for Groovy
and Kotlin as alternative languages on the JVM, and with the flexibility to create many
kinds of architectures depending on an application’s needs. As of Spring Framework 6.0,
Spring requires Java 17+.
items.translation: Spring 使创建 Java 企业级应用程序变得简单。它提供了在 enterprise 环境中采用 Java 语言所需的一切，支持 JVM 上的 Groovy 和 Kotlin 作为替代语言，并且能够根据应用程序的需求灵活创建多种架构。自 Spring Framework 6.0 起，Spring 需要 Java 17+。

items.source:
Spring supports a wide range of application scenarios. In a large enterprise, applications
often exist for a long time and have to run on a JDK and application server whose upgrade
cycle is beyond the developer’s control. Others may run as a single jar with the server embedded,
possibly in a cloud environment. Yet others may be standalone applications (such as batch
or integration workloads) that do not need a server.
items.translation: Spring 支持广泛的应用场景。在大型企业环境中，应用程序往往需要长期运行，且必须部署在开发者无法控制升级周期的 JDK 和应用服务器上；其他应用可能作为包含服务器的单个 jar 包运行，甚至部署在云环境中；还有一些则是独立的应用程序（例如批处理或集成工作负载），无需依赖服务器即可运行。

items.source:
Spring is open source. It has a large and active community that provides continuous feedback
based on a diverse range of real-world use cases. This has helped Spring to successfully
evolve over a very long time.
items.translation: Spring 是开源的。它拥有一个庞大且活跃的社区，该社区基于多样化的真实世界用例提供持续反馈。这帮助 Spring 在很长一段时间内成功演进。

items.source:
The term "Spring" means different things in different contexts. It can be used to refer to
the Spring Framework project itself, which is where it all started. Over time, other Spring
projects have been built on top of the Spring Framework. Most often, when people say
"Spring", they mean the entire family of projects. This reference documentation focuses on
the foundation: the Spring Framework itself.
items.translation: 术语 "Spring" 在不同上下文中具有不同的含义。它可以指代 Spring Framework 项目本身，也就是其起源之处。随着时间的推移，其他基于 Spring Framework 构建的 Spring 项目相继问世。通常，当人们提到 "Spring" 时，指的是整个项目家族。本参考文档专注于基础：即 Spring Framework 本身。

items.source:
The Spring Framework is divided into modules. Applications can choose which modules they need.
At the heart are the modules of the core container, including a configuration model and a
dependency injection mechanism. Beyond that, the Spring Framework provides foundational
support for different application architectures, including messaging, transactional data and
persistence, and web. It also includes the Servlet-based Spring MVC web framework and, in
parallel, the Spring WebFlux reactive web framework.
items.translation: Spring 框架被划分为多个模块。应用程序可以选择其所需的模块。核心是核心容器模块，包括配置模型和依赖注入机制。除此之外，Spring 框架为不同的应用程序架构提供基础支持，包括消息、事务数据和持久性以及 Web。它还包含基于 Servlet 的 Spring MVC Web 框架，以及并行提供的 Spring WebFlux 响应式 Web 框架。

items.source: as well as JTA/JCA setups for transaction coordination, if necessary.
items.translation: 以及必要时用于事务协调的 JTA/JCA 配置。

items.source:
Over time, the role of Java/Jakarta EE in application development has evolved. In the
early days of J2EE and Spring, applications were created to be deployed to an application
server. Today, with the help of Spring Boot, applications are created in a devops- and
cloud-friendly way, with the Servlet container embedded and trivial to change. As of
Spring Framework 5, a WebFlux application does not even use the Servlet API directly
and can run on servers (such as Netty) that are not Servlet containers.
items.translation: 随着时间的推移，Java/Jakarta EE 在应用程序开发中的作用已发生变化。在 J2EE 和 Spring 的早期阶段，应用程序被创建用于部署到应用服务器。如今，借助 Spring Boot，应用程序以有利于 DevOps 和云的方式创建，其中 Servlet 容器已嵌入且易于更改。自 Spring Framework 5 起，WebFlux 应用程序甚至不直接使用 Servlet API，并且可以在非 Servlet 容器（如 Netty）的服务器上运行。

items.source:
When you learn about a framework, it’s important to know not only what it does but what
principles it follows. Here are the guiding principles of the Spring Framework:
items.translation: 当您学习一个框架时，不仅需要了解它的作用，还需要了解它所遵循的原则。以下是 Spring 框架的指导原则：

items.source:
Provide choice at every level. Spring lets you defer design decisions as late as possible.
For example, you can switch persistence providers through configuration without changing
your code. The same is true for many other infrastructure concerns and integration with
third-party APIs.
items.translation: 在每个层级提供选择。Spring 允许您尽可能晚地推迟设计决策。例如，您可以通过配置切换持久化提供者，而无需更改代码。对于许多其他基础设施关注点以及与第三方 API 的集成，情况也是如此。

items.source:
Accommodate diverse perspectives. Spring embraces flexibility and is not opinionated
about how things should be done. It supports a wide range of application needs with
different perspectives.
items.translation: Spring 支持不同的观点，拥抱灵活性，不主张特定的实现方式。它通过不同的视角支持广泛的应用需求。

items.source:
Maintain strong backward compatibility. Spring’s evolution has been carefully managed
to force few breaking changes between versions. Spring supports a carefully chosen range
of JDK versions and third-party libraries to facilitate maintenance of applications and
libraries that depend on Spring.
items.translation: 保持强大的向后兼容性。Spring 的演进经过精心管理，以确保版本之间极少出现破坏性变更。Spring 支持经过仔细选择的 JDK 版本和第三方库范围，以促进依赖 Spring 的应用程序和库的维护。

items.source:
Care about API design. The Spring team puts a lot of thought and time into making APIs
that are intuitive and that hold up across many versions and many years.
items.translation: 关注 API 设计。Spring 团队投入了大量时间和精力，以设计出直观且能在多个版本和多年间保持稳定的 API。

items.source:
Set high standards for code quality. The Spring Framework puts a strong emphasis on
meaningful, current, and accurate javadoc. It is one of very few projects that can claim
clean code structure with  no circular dependencies between packages.
items.translation: 设定高标准的代码质量。Spring 框架高度重视有意义、最新且准确的 Javadoc。它是极少数能够宣称具有清晰代码结构且包之间不存在循环依赖的项目之一。
